kaikki_vikisozluk.e: تُرْكِيَا or تُرْكِيَّا • (turkiyā or turkiyyā) f
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Ultimately from Medieval Greek Τουρκίᾱ (Tourkíā, “Turkey”), itself being Τοῦρκος (Toûrkos) (borrowed into Latin as Turcus (“A Turk, Turkish”), see there for further etymology) with suffix -ίᾱ (-íā).
g: Turkey (a country in Europe and Asia)
